title: Deletion Evidence Record — Closed Vocabularies v0.1
description: Shared enumerations used by der.schema.json and ver.schema.json. These are closed vocabularies, not a scoring or maturity system — no numeric weight or ranking is implied by list order.

request_type.description: The category of event that triggered the deletion/data-exit action.

execution_status.description: Declared execution state of the deletion/data-exit action at the time this DER was recorded.

verification_status.description: Outcome of a later verification, review, or exception-handling activity against a parent DER.
